items.name: lumenmorph
items.title: Lumenmorph material
items.description: CSS glass surfaces that inherit your shadcn theme. No JavaScript required.
items.docs: For shadcn projects with Tailwind v4 color tokens. Add lumenmorph lumenmorph-border lumenmorph-theme to an existing surface. The material owns its background, border, radius and ::before; use --lumen-* variables to customize them. No global theme variables are changed.

items.name: lumen-card
items.title: Lumen Card
items.description: A glass surface composed with your existing shadcn Card.
items.docs: Use tone="theme" (default), "ember", "lagoon", or "lilac". Existing component props and refs are passed through. Your shadcn component supplies layout and behavior; Lumenmorph supplies its material.

items.name: lumen-button
items.title: Lumen Button
items.description: An illuminated shadcn Button that keeps native actions and focus behavior.
items.docs: Use tone="theme" (default), "ember", "lagoon", or "lilac". Existing component props and refs are passed through. Your shadcn component supplies layout and behavior; Lumenmorph supplies its material.

items.name: lumen-pointer
items.title: Lumen Pointer
items.description: Optional shared pointer light with cleanup and reduced-motion support.
items.docs: Mount <LumenPointer /> once in your app layout, not per card. Do not combine it with another trackPointer() on html. Set smooth={false} to disable its smoothing. Touch retains static light; reduced motion is respected. The component renders no wrapper and is safe to import during SSR.
